_note: Necessary conditions for an LLD (design documents). Code checks each one on lld.md after every build; the LLD is workable only when all are met and Audit accepts. "check" names the code check in j2.condition_met(). "plan" (optional): words a workflow in Adaptation's plan must mention, or the plan is flagged before building.

conditions.text: All five sections are present and not empty
Section, element and field ids are unique, and every section has an id
Every interactive element has a selector, a trigger and a behaviour
Every form field has a name, a type and a required flag
Every HLD component appears in an LLD section
conditions.label: HLD components

conditions.text: No invented facts: every number, email and proper name comes from the charter, the Requester's answers or the earlier documents, or sits in an Assumption: line
